policy.text: A caller creating a document share must have view_document permission for the exact shared document. A global add_sharelink permission or knowing a document ID alone is insufficient.

questions.request: For a principal asking to share an existing document through ShareLinkViewSet, determine which endpoint and object controls apply to that exact document before the share is created, including relevant inherited permission and serializer paths; compare the source behavior with the supplied policy, explain policy compliance, and identify specific missing facts. Do not assume that document existence or a global model permission grants access to the document.
questions.principal: the principal asking to share the existing document

premises.text: The principal asks to share an existing document.

Document existence or a global model permission must not be assumed to grant access to the document.
